idea-plugin.name: AZSL Language Support
idea-plugin.description:
AZSL (Amazon Shader Language / O3DE)

Syntax highlighting, code completion, go-to-declaration, folding, brace matching, commenting and azslc validation for O3DE shader files.

  • File extensions: .azsl, .azsli, .srgi
  • Shader Resource Groups (SRG): ShaderResourceGroup, partial ShaderResourceGroup, ShaderResourceGroupSemantic
  • Shader Options: option bool, option enum class with defaults
  • SRG Frequency Semantics: SRG_PerDraw, SRG_PerObject, SRG_PerMaterial, SRG_PerSubPass, SRG_PerPass, SRG_PerPass_WithFallback, SRG_PerView, SRG_PerScene, SRG_Bindless, SRG_RayTracingGlobal, SRG_RayTracingScene, SRG_RayTracingMaterial
  • Sampler State Properties: AddressU/V/W, MinFilter, MagFilter, MipFilter, ComparisonFunc, BorderColor, MaxAnisotropy, MipLODBias, MaxLOD, MinLOD
  • Sampler State Values: Wrap, Clamp, Mirror, Border, MirrorOnce, Point, Linear, Anisotropic, comparison functions
  • azslc validation: real-time errors/warnings via the official O3DE AZSL compiler (with cpp preprocessing and engine include-path resolution)
  • azslc tool window: run --srg / --options / --ia / --bindingdep on the current file
  • Structure view: SRGs, SRG semantics, structs, enums, functions and shader options
  • Hover documentation for built-ins, types, SRG semantics and sampler states
  • Live templates: srg, srgsem, option, sampler, struct, vs, ps, cs
  • New file templates: AZSL File (.azsl), AZSL Include (.azsli) and Shader File (.shader) offered in the New context menu
  • Go to declaration and completion across O3DE engine/project includes (auto-detected roots)
  • Intentions: Add '#pragma once'
  • clang-format integration with optional format-on-save
  • Color scheme: Settings → Editor → Color Scheme → AZSL

Additional extensions can be added via Settings → Editor → File Types.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.17.0 - New file menu entries

  • New file templates: right-click → New now offers AZSL File (.azsl), AZSL Include (.azsli) and Shader File (.shader)
  • Templates are editable under Settings → Editor → File and Code Templates → Files
  • .azsli files start with #pragma once

v1.16.0 - AZSL only

  • AZSL-only plugin: removed all HLSL language support and DXC validation
  • AZSL (Amazon Shader Language) support for O3DE shader development
  • File extensions: .azsl, .azsli, .srgi
  • Dedicated icons and file types for .azsl and .azsli
  • Shader Resource Groups (SRG), Shader Options, SRG Frequency Semantics, Sampler States
  • azslc validation (cpp preprocess + azslc --syntax/--semantic/--full) with include-path resolution
  • Separate AZSL color scheme (Settings → Editor → Color Scheme → AZSL)
  • Full IDE integration: completion, go-to-declaration, folding, brace matching, commenting, clang-format, azslc validation
  • Dropped .shader: CLion/Rider's C++ backend owns that extension (built-in Shader file type)
